title: Prediction of Transcription Factor Binding Sites Using a Combined Deep Learning Approach.
authors: Cao, Linan; Liu, Pei; Chen, Jialong; Deng, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文提出结合CNN、BiLSTM与注意力机制的DeepARC模型，利用位置嵌入预测转录因子结合位点，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作且具备AI方法创新与可解释性，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: In the process of regulating gene expression and evolution, such as DNA replication and mRNA transcription, the binding of transcription factors (TFs) to TF binding sites (TFBS) plays a vital role. Precisely modeling the specificity of genes and searching for TFBS are helpful to explore the mechanism of cell expression. In recent years, computational and deep learning methods searching for TFBS have become an active field of research. However, existing methods generally cannot meet high performance and interpretability simultaneously. Here, we develop an accurate and interpretable attention-based hybrid approach, DeepARC, that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN) to predict TFBS. DeepARC employs a positional embedding method to extract the hidden embedding from DNA sequences, including the positional information from OneHot encoding and the distributed embedding from DNA2Vec. DeepARC feeds the positional embedding of the DNA sequence into a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention-based framework to complete the task of finding the motif. Taking advantage of the attention mechanism, DeepARC can gain greater access to valuable information about the motif and bring interpretability to the work of searching for motifs through the attention weight graph. Moreover, DeepARC achieves promising performances with an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) score of 0.908 on five cell lines (A549, GM12878, Hep-G2, H1-hESC, and Hela) in the benchmark dataset. We also compare the positional embedding with OneHot and DNA2Vec and gain a competitive advantage.
abstract_zh: 在调控基因表达和进化的过程中，如DNA复制和mRNA转录，转录因子（TFs）与转录因子结合位点（TFBS）的结合起着至关重要的作用。精确建模基因特异性并搜索TFBS有助于探索细胞表达机制。近年来，利用计算和深度学习方法搜索TFBS已成为一个活跃的研究领域。然而，现有方法通常无法同时满足高性能和可解释性。在此，我们开发了一种准确且可解释的基于注意力的混合方法DeepARC，它结合了卷积神经网络（CNN）和循环神经网络（RNN）来预测TFBS。DeepARC采用位置嵌入方法从DNA序列中提取隐藏嵌入，包括来自OneHot编码的位置信息和来自DNA2Vec的分布式嵌入。DeepARC将DNA序列的位置嵌入输入到基于CNN-BiLSTM-Attention的框架中，以完成寻找基序的任务。利用注意力机制的优势，DeepARC能够更有效地获取关于基序的有价值信息，并通过注意力权重图赋予搜索基序工作可解释性。此外，DeepARC在基准数据集上的五个细胞系（A549、GM12878、Hep-G2、H1-hESC和Hela）上取得了有前景的性能，平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）得分为0.908。我们还将位置嵌入与OneHot和DNA2Vec进行了比较，并获得了竞争优势。
